Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Position Overview
Tencent Cloud is seeking a motivated Solution Architecture Intern to support enterprise cloud solution design and technical engagement activities in Thailand. This internship offers hands-on exposure to cloud technologies, solution consulting, and customer-facing projects across multiple industries. You will work closely with experienced Solution Architects, sales teams, and engineering teams to gain practical knowledge of Tencent Cloud products, industry use cases, and solution design methodologies. This role is ideal for students who are passionate about cloud computing and aspire to build a career in solution architecture, technical consulting, or cloud technologies.
Responsibilities
Support Solution Architects in customer engagements, technical discussions, and solution design activities for enterprise customers in Thailand
Participate in requirement gathering sessions to understand customer business needs and technical challenges
Assist in preparing solution proposals, architecture diagrams, technical presentations, and product demonstrations
Support Proof-of-Concept (POC) setup, testing, validation, and documentation activities
Conduct market and technology research on cloud computing, AI, big data, and industry-specific solution trends
Collaborate with product, engineering, and sales teams to support customer success and solution delivery initiatives

Who We Look For
Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or related technical disciplines
Available for a minimum 6-month full-time internship commitment
Basic understanding of cloud computing concepts, including IaaS, PaaS, virtualization, networking, and storage technologies
Familiarity with Linux, databases, container technologies, or cloud platforms such as Tencent Cloud, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or Alibaba Cloud is advantageous
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn new technologies in a fast-paced environment
Good communication skills in English and Thai; Mandarin proficiency is a plus for collaboration with regional and headquarters stakeholders

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Thailand-Bangkok
